practice_units.title: Monarchy vs Democracy
practice_units.problem: Highlight three key differences between a Monarchy and a Democracy.
guidance: Consider how the leader is chosen (birth vs. election).
Think about who has the final say (king vs. people/representatives).
Consider accountability (to God/nobles vs. to voters).
practice_units.solution: 1. Source of power (Inheritance vs. Election). 2. Decision making (Absolute vs. Constitutional). 3. Accountability (None vs. Regular elections).
